items.title: AI Agent Use for Coding in 2025
items.summary: Qualitative study of how experienced developers steer AI coding agents in practice.
items.detailHtml:
We study how professional software developers actually use AI agents for coding in 2025—when they delegate, when they intervene, and how they maintain control over design and correctness rather than only “vibing” with suggestions.

With Ruanqianqian (Lisa) Huang, Sorin Lerner, Haijun Xia, and Brian Hempel.

items.title: Help Supporters
items.summary: CHI '24 paper on assistive tech for spontaneous help between blind and sighted people.
items.detailHtml:
We explore the design space of assistive technologies that make face-to-face help between blind and sighted strangers easier—supporting coordination, trust, and lightweight interaction in public settings.

With Yuanyang Teng, Connor Courtien, David Rios, Yves Tseng, Jacqueline Gibson, Maryam Aziz, Rajan Vaish, and Brian Smith.

Project site

items.title: Spatial Interactions
items.summary: ASSETS '23 study on spatial interaction attitudes in desktop screen readers.
items.detailHtml:
We report blind and low vision users’ attitudes toward spatial interactions in desktop screen readers—what feels useful, what feels fragile, and how spatial metaphors fit (or clash) with existing navigation strategies.

With Arnavi Chheda-Kothary, David Rios, Kynnedy Simone Smith, Cecilia Zhang, and Brian Smith.

items.title: Metrics Playground
items.summary: Taught Cyber D&M engineers about agentic software development
items.detailHtml: A hands-on playground for metrics and evaluation workflows aimed at Cyber D&M engineers, focused on how agentic software development changes instrumentation, feedback loops, and what we choose to measure.

items.title: Admin Metrics Dashboard
items.summary: In-house monitoring dashboard to replace Grafana cyber logs
items.detailHtml: An in-house admin dashboard for cyber log monitoring, designed to replace a Grafana-heavy setup with views tuned to our operators’ workflows, alert semantics, and day-to-day triage habits.

items.title: ILM Portal
items.summary: Identity lifecycle portal for custom authorization plugins
items.detailHtml: A portal for identity lifecycle management that supports custom authorization plugins—onboarding, changes, and deprovisioning—so policy and access stay aligned as systems evolve.

items.title: File Upload Tool
items.summary: Validating native content for IAM analytics
items.detailHtml: A file upload and validation path for native content feeding IAM analytics—checking format, completeness, and consistency before data lands in downstream reporting and access models.

items.title: Penetration Test Checklists
items.summary: Rendering editable spreadsheets of simulated cyberattacks
items.detailHtml: Editable spreadsheet-style checklists for penetration testing—structuring simulated attack scenarios, findings, and follow-ups so teams can collaborate without losing the rigor of a formal test record.
